revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2026 growth was 3.3% (87,032 vs 84,284), FY2025 0.3%; mature staples, modest organic growth near 3-3.5%, fading to near terminal growth.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: held at FY2026 margin 19,748/87,032 = 22.7% (FY2025 24.3%, FY2024 22.1%); no expansion assumed.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: US federal statutory rate; FY2026 implied effective ~21% (net income 16,046 / pretax 20,377). Damodaran industry effective rate 6.5% judged unrepresentative.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: between FY2026 5.1% (4,409/87,032) and FY2025 4.5%; 3-year average ~4.7%, rounded to 4.8% given recent capex step-up.

wacc.source: CAPM: rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta 0.847 x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = CoE 8.64%; beta = cash-corrected unlevered 0.741 relevered at Damodaran Household Products D/E 0.1815 with 21% tax (no share price available for PG's own D/E); pretax Kd 5.29% (Damodaran) -> 4.18% after tax; weights 84.6% E / 15.4% D -> ~7.95%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below long-run nominal US GDP growth and below the 4.86% risk-free rate; mature staples franchise.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt: total debt 34,138 (LT debt noncurrent 22,842 + current debt 11,296) - cash 9,942; no short-term investments reported; accession 0000080424-26-000103
